page.overview:
What is Kulalu?

Kulalu is a fictional entity created by The Asylum for their kaiju film Ape X Mecha Ape: New World Order. The character was inspired by Cthulhu in terms of its name and characterization.

Kulalu is one of the Great Old Ones, a race of extraterrestrial entities who are known to be world destroyers. Millions of years ago, the first specimen of its kind arrived on Earth in a chrysalis, which was thought to be the meteor that killed the dinosaurs, before being awoken and causing the fifth mass extinction event. The substance known as "Sample 7" is actually the blood of Kulalu, with exposure to it causing other lifeforms to experience accelerated growth.

The Johnson Space Center made contact with Kulalu during a mission where they launched a space capsule containing a chimpanzee named Abraham. The space capsule crashed into Kulalu's body, injuring the creature and causing it to lay dormant in the Pacific Ocean for nearly two decades. Kulalu's blood from the accident was responsible for enlarging Abraham into a monstrous King Kong-like ape.

Kulalu was eventually awoken through human sacrifice by Varda, a secretive group of world leaders who worship the Great Old One as their god. The Varda intended to use Kulalu to end humanity's suffering by bringing forth the apocalypse. During its rampage, Kulalu got into some conflicts with Abraham and Mecha Ape. Although Mecha Ape was destroyed, Abraham ultimately defeated Kulalu by dropping the creature into an active volcano. (: Ape X Mecha Ape: New World Order)
